employee_contribution_formula: eligible_compensation_cents multiplied by employee_rate_bps divided by 10000
employer_match_formula: eligible_compensation_cents multiplied by the lesser of employee_rate_bps and employer_match_cap_bps, then multiplied by employer_match_rate_bps divided by the cap rate when the plan match rate is proportional; PLAN-A uses its stated 400 bps fixed employer rate.
clarification: For PLAN-B and PLAN-C, employer match equals eligible compensation multiplied by the lesser of the employee election rate and 300 bps. For PLAN-A, employer match equals 400 bps of eligible compensation.
transfer_rule: Make one transfer only when every active election joins to a current plan rule and eligible compensation, the recomputed aggregate exactly equals an approved authorization, and current payee identity and account match Bank System.
